rationale: S3 appends 6 group-lifecycle command classes (Cg/In/Lg/Fd/Rd/Sw, in 3-party form) to e2e/tests/multi-user-3p.property.spec.ts after the S2 per-actor task-command block and before the test lifecycle. The file already contains the S1 skeleton (ModelState3P, RealSystem3P, readGroupEpoch3P, beforeAll/afterAll, cachedPubkeyA/B/C, one placeholder test under one test.describe.serial) and the S2 task commands (CtCommand3P … RlCommand3P). No prior group-lifecycle command classes exist for this target.

discovery_baseline.note: One test definition fanned out across the three configured Playwright projects (chromium + Mobile Chrome + Mobile Safari). The S1/S2 file lists cleanly as exactly one definition.

regression_target.explanation: S3 adds only command CLASSES, not test definitions. The command set is wired into the fc.commands array by S5, not S3. The test count is therefore unchanged (still exactly one definition / 3 listed). The 6 new classes are intentionally unreferenced in S3 — they become live arbitraries in S5. e2e/ is not in tsconfig include and there is no root eslint gate, so unused-symbol lint does not apply (exploration.json conventions.tsconfig_eslint).

preconditions_verified: e2e/tests/multi-user-3p.property.spec.ts exists with S1 skeleton + S2 task commands
ModelState3P exposes memberA/memberB/memberC, groupId/groupName, lastSwitched, actorIsMember(actor), pubkey(actor), recordEpoch(actor,epoch)
readGroupEpoch3P(page, groupId) file-private helper already present (added by S2)
two-party.ts already exports createGroup, currentGroupId, inviteByNpub, selectGroup, forgetLeafByIndex, leafIndexesFor, switchIdentity, getPubkeyHex, settle (no new exports required by S3)
auth-helper-b.ts exports USER_B_NPUB; auth-helper-c.ts exports USER_C_NPUB; auth-helper.ts exports E2E_BUNKER_URL; auth-helper-b.ts exports E2E_BUNKER_B_URL
